problem_summary.summary: Check whether subRoot matches a node of root together with all of that node's descendants.
problem_summary.input_output: Input: roots root and subRoot. Return whether subRoot is structurally and value-identical to a subtree of root.

brute_force.explanation: Try every node in the main tree as a possible subtree root and compare both trees recursively from that candidate.
brute_force.correctness_idea: Every subtree must be rooted at some node of root. Exact comparison at each candidate checks both its full shape and values, so a successful candidate is precisely a matching subtree.
brute_force.time_complexity: O(nm) worst case, where n and m are the node counts, due to repeated comparisons.
brute_force.space_complexity: O(h + k) recursion stack for main-tree height h and candidate height k.

optimized.explanation: Serialize both trees in preorder with an explicit null token, then use Knuth-Morris-Pratt pattern matching to find the subRoot token sequence in root's sequence.
optimized.correctness_idea: Preorder serialization with null markers uniquely encodes tree structure and values. Therefore a complete serialized subRoot sequence occurs in root exactly when it is rooted at a node as a structurally identical subtree; KMP finds that sequence in linear time.
optimized.time_complexity: O(n + m) — serialization and KMP scanning are linear in the two tree sizes.
optimized.space_complexity: O(n + m) auxiliary for serialized tokens and the KMP prefix table.

steps.event: Serialize root in preorder with null markers.
steps.condition: Each absent child emits the dedicated null token.

steps.event: Serialize subRoot and build the KMP prefix table.
steps.condition: The pattern encodes node 3 and both complete child positions.
Tokens from index 1 match the entire pattern.
steps.action: Return true; the tree rooted at value 3 is identical to subRoot.

edge_cases.handling: The serialized pattern matches at the start of the main serialization.
Null markers cause the serialized sequences to differ.

edge_cases.case: Repeated values in the main tree
edge_cases.handling: KMP checks full structural token sequences rather than values alone.
